text_to_speech: Hello astronom…… Hey mr. Giotto, don’t steal my job please! I know you also had the need to calibrate your “pictures” and this is why we gave your name to our new smart flat field generator! Welcome to: GIOTTO! GIOTTO is the flat field generator we designed to help you capture flat calibration frames for your astrophotography! GIOTTO uses special LED lights with color temperature similar to the one of the Sun and a specially designed light diffuser to provide a uniform source of illumination. In the bottom part of GIOTTO you will find the control panel with USB type-C port to let you easily connect to EAGLE or any standard Windows computer. It also comes with WiFi connectivity so you can wirelessly control it by using your smartphone or tablet using the included Virtual HandPad! It runs off of a 12V source so you won’t need an external power supply, and the integrated control electronics allow you adjust GIOTTO’s light intensity by 100 steps. GIOTTO flat field generator is available in many different diameters from 120 up to 430mm so you can find the one that best fits your telescope’s diameter! And we can design even larger diameters on request! When it’s time to record your flat frames to calibrate your pictures and remove dust and vignetting, you can simply attach GIOTTO to the front of your telescope by locking it in place with the included thumbscrews. And you can also convert GIOTTO in a remotely controlled motorized cap by adding the new ALTO motor that clamps to any dovetail bar to perfectly set its opening and closing position! You can control GIOTTO with PLAY astrophotography software that allows you to easily record calibration files for your astrophotography session. And it also comes with a dedicated ASCOM driver to let you control it through third party astrophotography softwares. This is GIOTTO, the smart flat field generator, that can be used also as a great motorized telescope cap by adding ALTO motor!

youtube_description:
GIOTTO is the Smart Flat Field Generator we designed to help you capture flat calibration frames for telescopes. GIOTTO uses many LED lights at a color temperature similar to the Sun, a specially designed light diffuser and, thanks to the included thumbscrews, you can easily lock it in front of telescopes. GIOTTO is provided with integrated electronics that allow you adjust GIOTTO’s light intensity by 100 steps (0 to 100%), USB-C port to let you connect to your EAGLE or any standard Windows computer for remote control with PLAY or ASCOM driver, WiFi connectivity to let you wirelessly control it using your smartphone or tablet via the included Virtual HandPad and 12V power port! And if you want to automate the capture of your calibration files or if you're searching for the best way to remotely open and close your telescope, you can add the optional ALTO telescope cover motor and use GIOTTO as a remotely controlled motorized cap!

Discover GIOTTO in our website https://www.primalucelab.com/calibration/
